author: homelab
name: Compose secret/config changed on Unraid
description: Port of Wazuh 100025: osquery boot_config_hashes diff on a stack's .env or docker-compose.y(a)ml. Counts only added rows: osquery reports a modification as a removed+added pair (2c-2 review).
query: osquery.name:boot_config_hashes and osquery.action:added and osquery.counter > 0 and file.path:(/boot/config/compose/*/.env or /boot/config/compose/*/docker-compose.yml or /boot/config/compose/*/docker-compose.yaml)
